title: MoVoC: Morphology-Aware Subword Construction for Geez Script Languages Corrected version
abstract: arXiv:2509.08812v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Subword-based tokenization methods often fail to preserve morphological boundaries, a limitation especially pronounced in low-resource, morphologically complex languages such as those written in the Ge'ez script. To address this, we present Morpheme-aware Subword Vocabulary Construction (MoVoC) and train MoVoC-Tok, a tokenizer that integrates supervised morphological analysis into the subword vocabulary. This hybrid segmentation approach combines morpheme-based and Byte Pair Encoding (BPE) tokens to preserve morphological integrity while maintaining lexical meaning. To tackle resource scarcity, we release morpheme-annotated data for four Ge'ez script languages (169,806 records) and a morpheme-aware vocabulary for two of them. translated_title: MoVoC：面向吉兹文字语言的形态感知子词构建（修正版）
translated_abstract: 基于子词的分词方法通常无法保留形态边界，这一局限在低资源且形态复杂的语言（如使用吉兹文字书写的语言）中尤为突出。为解决这一问题，我们提出了形态感知子词词表构建方法，并训练了 MoVoC-Tok——一种将监督式形态分析融入子词词表的分词器。这种混合分割方法结合了基于词素的标记与字节对编码（BPE）标记，在保持词汇意义的同时保留了形态完整性。为应对资源稀缺问题，我们发布了四种吉兹文字语言的词素标注数据（共 169,806 条记录），以及其中两种语言的形态感知词表。在所有对比实验中，评分均在从约束该语言 MoVoC-Tok 的词素资源中留出的词汇上进行，MoVoC-Tok 在四种语言中的三种获得了最高的 MorphScore，并取得了最高的形态……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出 MoVoC 形态感知子词构建方法，将监督式形态分析与 BPE 相结合训练分词器 MoVoC-Tok 以保留形态完整性，并发布四种吉兹文字语言的词素标注数据（169,806 条），在四种语言中的三种取得最高的 MorphScore。
en_tdlr: MoVoC integrates supervised morphological analysis into subword vocabulary construction, training MoVoC-Tok to combine morpheme-based and BPE tokens for preserving morphological integrity, and releases 169,806 morpheme-annotated records for four Ge'ez script languages, achieving the highest MorphScore in three of the four languages.
